name: What kind of materials and features are popular in custom kitchen designs today?

mainEntity.name: What kind of materials and features are popular in custom kitchen designs today?

acceptedAnswer.text: Today's custom kitchen designs often feature elements that enhance both aesthetics and functionality. Popular choices include custom cabinetry for optimized storage, durable quartz or natural-stone countertops, elegant tile backsplashes, and integrated, energy-efficient appliances. Under-cabinet lighting, large kitchen islands for prep and entertaining, and open-concept layouts are also highly sought after. AKN Design Group helps homeowners in the Dallas–Fort Worth metroplex select materials that align with their style and lifestyle, ensuring longevity and a cohesive design.
acceptedAnswer.description: Popular custom kitchen features include custom cabinetry, quartz/natural stone countertops, tile backsplashes, integrated appliances, under-cabinet lighting, and large kitchen islands.
